source:
Marta: The Lynx should start the rookie point guard while Ellis is out six weeks. The team already knows the offense will be rough, but those minutes will make the rookie playable by the playoffs.
Gio: Sign a veteran for the six-week stretch. Everyone agrees Ellis is out and the rookie needs reps, but if they hand him thirty minutes now, the Lynx will lose the home-court seed before Ellis returns.
Marta: The schedule is soft enough to absorb the mistakes.
Gio: The next ten games include five road back-to-backs, so the soft-schedule argument is wishful.
